messages:
nico_cs: drafting note for customers impacted by onboarding ingestion slowdown. want to keep it tight: succinct RCA, clear mitigation, ETA, credit offer, and RSVP for office hours. please review.

elaine_eng: RCA: a misapplied routing flag bumped a subset of ingestion queues into a lower-rate class around 04:05 UTC which throttled some worker shards. rollback at 04:22 UTC, backfill started. current throughput ~82%. estimate full catch-up 5-6 hours. incident INC-2026-61333.

sam_pm: call out renewal-sensitive customers so AE can triage. offer a 30-minute implementation review and a one-time onboarding/implementation credit. tone: apologetic + concrete.

nico_cs: outbound draft (please edit inline):

nico_cs: ```Hi <Customer>,
We9re sorry. Earlier today (around 04:003:40 UTC) a configuration routing change briefly slowed our onboarding ingestion pipeline, delaying processing of new uploads and trial imports. We reverted the change and triggered a backfill; processing is underway and we expect full catch-up within ~56 hours.

Root cause: a routing flag misconfiguration put some queue shards into a low-rate class (INC-2026-61333).
What we did: rolled back the change, temporarily increased backfill worker capacity by 3x, patched queue routing, and added extra monitoring.
Impact: no data loss; search and embedding completeness will be restored once backfill completes.
Next steps: we9re hosting office hours today at 16:30 UTC (RSVP link). We9re offering a one-time onboarding/implementation credit up to $300 for affected onboarding windows. If you9re in a renewal window or would like prioritized help, reply and we9ll schedule a 30-minute review with Solutions Engineering and your AE.
Apologies for the disruption and thanks for your patience.
— Nico, Customer Success```

maya_se: I can host office hour and will attach a 1-page troubleshooting checklist + RSVP form. I9ll capture blockers and common questions to feed back to eng.

status_bot: INC-2026-61333 status: RESOLVED (rollback + backfill in progress). public status: https://redwood.status/incidents/INC-2026-61333 :white_check_mark:

elaine_eng: legal approved the credit phrasing as "one-time onboarding/implementation credit up to $300"; legal will DM exact T&C language and add a short clause about "credits applied at company discretion."

sam_pm: I9ll flag renewal accounts and notify AE owners for SEP handoffs. add a one-question feedback checkbox in the outbound about whether the delay impacted renewal decisions.

nico_cs: final pre-send checklist: 1) include legal T&C link 2) append renewal flag list 3) add RSVP + calendar invites 4) AE/SEP tags. target send 10:30 UTC. will post final copy here before sending. :thumbsup:
